guarantees.claim: All combinational outputs are assigned inactive default values (0, Disable, etc.) before state-specific logic, preventing latches and ensuring defined safe behavior if a state branch misses an assignment.

In StCtrlReset, any op_start_i without advance_sel is flagged as invalid_op; if inv_state is true, forces transition to StCtrlWipe; otherwise if advance_sel is asserted, transitions to StCtrlEntropyReseed.
In StCtrlEntropyReseed, asserts prng_reseed_req_o and waits for prng_reseed_ack_i; on ack, transitions to StCtrlRandom.
In StCtrlRandom, asserts random_req; when internal counter cnt equals EntropyRounds-1, asserts random_ack and transitions to StCtrlRootKey.
In StCtrlRootKey, asserts init_o and initialized; transitions to StCtrlInit if en_i and root_key_valid_q are both true, otherwise transitions to StCtrlWipe.

In StCtrlInit, sets op_req = op_start_i, selects stage_sel_o as Creator if advance_sel else Disable; invalid_op flags op_start_i without advance_sel or disable_sel; transitions to StCtrlWipe if !en_i or inv_state, to StCtrlDisabled if dis_state, or to StCtrlCreatorRootKey if adv_state.

In StCtrlCreatorRootKey, sets op_req = op_start_i; stage_sel_o selects Disable if disable_sel, OwnerInt if advance_sel, else Creator; transitions to StCtrlWipe if !en_i or inv_state, to StCtrlDisabled if dis_state, or to StCtrlOwnerIntKey if adv_state.

In StCtrlOwnerIntKey, sets op_req = op_start_i; stage_sel_o selects Disable if disable_sel, Owner if advance_sel, else OwnerInt; transitions to StCtrlWipe if !en_i or inv_state, to StCtrlDisabled if dis_state, or to StCtrlOwnerKey if adv_state.

In StCtrlOwnerKey, sets op_req = op_start_i; stage_sel_o selects Disable if advance_sel or disable_sel, else Owner; transitions to StCtrlWipe if !en_i or inv_state, else to StCtrlDisabled if adv_state or dis_state, also sets prng_en_dis_inv_set in that case.

In StCtrlWipe, asserts wipe_req; holds op_req = op_busy to complete ongoing operation; flags any new op_start_i as invalid_op; when op_start_i is low, transitions to StCtrlInvalid and sets prng_en_dis_inv_set.
In StCtrlDisabled, sets op_req = op_start_i and asserts disabled flag; transitions to StCtrlWipe if either !en_i or inv_state is true.
In StCtrlInvalid, flags any op_start_i as invalid_op and asserts invalid signal; does not change state.
If state_q takes an illegal value not matching any defined state, the default branch sets state_intg_err_d = 1 and forces state_d = StCtrlWipe.
guarantees.cond: state_q not equal to any enumerated state

assumptions.claim: state_q must always be a legal enumerated value; any illegal encoding will trigger default wipe path, potentially destroying key material.
assumptions.risk: Transient bit-flip in state register could be treated as fault and wipe keys, but if fault is not caught in time, may allow invalid state transitions before wipe.

assumptions.claim: inv_state signal is asserted only on a genuine structural integrity fault; the FSM immediately wipes keys in most states upon seeing inv_state.
assumptions.risk: False assertion of inv_state (e.g., due to glitch) causes premature key wipe and denial of service.

assumptions.claim: prng_reseed_ack_i is guaranteed to be asserted after prng_reseed_req_o is raised; no timeout or fallback is implemented.
assumptions.risk: If PRNG hardware hangs and never acks, the key manager stalls forever in entropy reseed state.

assumptions.claim: op_busy correctly reflects an ongoing transaction and will eventually deassert after op_req and op_start_i protocol completes.
assumptions.cond: during wipe state when op_start_i is high
assumptions.risk: If op_busy is stuck high, the FSM cannot transition to Invalid and may hang, though op_start_i low would still force transition.

assumptions.claim: root_key_valid_q is asserted only when the root key is truly valid and available; a false low will force immediate transition to StCtrlWipe, destroying key state.
assumptions.risk: Transient invalid indicator (e.g., due to a timing pulse) causes unnecessary full key wipe and loss of secure operation.

assumptions.claim: advance_sel, disable_sel, adv_state, and dis_state are decoded exclusively such that in any state where multiple could be true, priority implicit in the code (disable over advance) does not violate system-level intent.
assumptions.risk: If both advance and disable are asserted, the FSM may take a path that the software didn't intend, possibly skipping key progression or incorrect wipe sequence.

uncertain_points.claim: When StCtrlRootKey transitions to StCtrlWipe because en_i deasserts or root_key_valid_q is false, prng_en_dis_inv_set is not set, unlike other wipe-inducing transitions (Init, Creator, Owner) where it is set. This may leave the PRNG state not invalidated on a root-key failure.
uncertain_points.risk: PRNG output may not be cleared or reseeded after a forced key wipe, potentially leaking deterministic state or enabling subsequent key extraction.

uncertain_points.claim: In StCtrlWipe, the transition to StCtrlInvalid occurs only when op_start_i is low. If op_start_i remains asserted while op_busy is stuck high, the FSM may deadlock. It is unclear if there is a hardware guarantee that op_start_i will eventually deassert after a timeout.
uncertain_points.cond: state_q == StCtrlWipe and op_start_i remains high and op_busy stuck
uncertain_points.risk: Permanent hang in wipe state prevents entering Invalid and may stall system-level key recovery.

uncertain_points.claim: In StCtrlInit, the invalid_op expression excludes operations that are not advance_sel and not disable_sel, but the state accepts only those two decoded operations. However, if a future command is added, this would incorrectly mark it invalid. No specification defines the full command set accepted at this state.
uncertain_points.cond: state_q == StCtrlInit and op_start_i with a new command
uncertain_points.risk: Functional bug if a yet-unimplemented legal command is issued; it would be treated as invalid and ignored.

uncertain_points.claim: StCtrlEntropyReseed waits indefinitely for prng_reseed_ack_i; there is no timeout or error recovery. If the PRNG fails to ack, the key manager will never leave this state.
uncertain_points.cond: state_q == StCtrlEntropyReseed and prng_reseed_ack_i stuck at 0
uncertain_points.risk: Permanent stall of the key manager, rendering the entire system non-functional.
